Dagosa Consultores ofrece Local en C/ del Cardenal Silíceo, 14

Tiene una superficie de 346 m² distribuidos en varias dependencias en planta calle.
En la planta baja de edificio construido en 1985, con acceso directo e independiente desde la calle.

inv.desc_en:
Dagosa Consultores offers a commercial space located at C/ del Cardenal Siliceo, 14.

It has an area of 346 m² distributed in several rooms on the ground floor.
On the ground floor of a building constructed in 1985, with direct and independent access from the street.
It is located in the Prosperidad neighborhood, with good road access and nearby bus and metro stops. In the surrounding area you can find services such as supermarkets, restaurants, government offices, institutes, health centers, and other commercial businesses.

Dagosa Consultores, We are a consulting firm, a real estate broker specializing in the integral commercialization of commercial premises, business expansion, offices and investment. Madrid capital and its entire province.
